license.preparation_application: Retain roneneldan,52AI,Gabrui attributions, pinned revisions, source-row hashes, license link and notices of filtering/dedup/encoding. This sidecar has not published a new corpus externally.
license.upstream_label_discrepancy: 52AI and Robin declare MIT while original and Gabrui declare CDLA-Sharing. Prefer the explicit Gabrui sharing license and keep all upstream notices; label mismatch does not prove bad rights but is not permission to discard obligations.

local_existing_source.decision: No new raw scan. Prior formula/markup damage and specific entity concentration remain valid. Strict daily-language gate failure does not rule out broader intact encyclopedic prose; it is a secondary option, not a new clean source.

sampling.method: random.Random(20261108).sample(range(575898),32), sorted for review; no quality selection
sampling.scope: First TRAIN shard only. Uniform sampling within that shard; not representative of all five shards by design.
sampling.range_attempts: Remote attempt1 completed first3 shards then502, losing unsaved samples; capped24MiB. Attempt2 stopped after main local shard became available; bounded persisted range evidence retained. Neither attempt formed the manually reviewed sample. No further network tooling used.
sampling.dependency: PyArrow19.0.1 isolated in review-local vendor; project venv unchanged

manual_review.reviewer: Single development-agent qualitative annotation, not human evaluation, native-speaker verification or independent blind assessment.

rubric.clean: No obvious grammatical/translation/entity/causal problem on this read; not certified perfect.
rubric.minor: Main story remains readable; transliteration variants, literal wording, minor pronoun or template issues warrant filtering/spot-checking but do not by themselves rule out a bounded pilot.
rubric.major: Meaning-affecting object/relationship substitution, reversed action, broken sentence or material local continuity problem; exclude from high-quality pilot candidates.
rubric.fiction_policy: Explicit fictional prose. Anthropomorphism, magic and unrealistic events are expected, not factual errors by themselves. Neither encyclopedia evidence nor model autobiographical experience.

annotations.note: 球分成两部分可作幻想，但发挥自己的作用、球权进球和同一个球的指代混乱，无法稳定理解物体状态。
蒂米/提米交替；吵闹的花可能是幻想，也可能是直译，缺少声音行为解释，列疑点而非按幻想拒绝。
狗从斯波变斯波特再变斑点，末段发现一棵树与之相配句意损坏；找到石头的情节仍能辨认。
摘草莓译成选下来；正在拉包的拉链却变成门打不开，实体连续性损坏。猫头鹰说话不是问题。
树下干燥译成天干了，结尾玩耍、玩耍重复；避雨因果可辨但关键位置表达错误。
虫子说话和参与游戏明确属于故事幻想，人物反应、冲突和结尾连续。
玩具小车被称大马车，拉车与开车措辞摇摆，整理玩具称排序生硬；主线仍可理解。
开头已住在小屋又羡慕并请求进入小屋，背景矛盾；弗罗斯蒂/Frosty/霜/小霜混用；融化后移到室外的因果清楚。
主体始终为一个女孩，末句突用他们；梦想、存钱、买玩具过程清楚，但幸福生活结尾模板不贴合。
同一手足先妹妹、后姐姐、再妹妹，亲属关系不稳定；受伤后和解的主线可读。
洗干净一座山是夸张童话设定，不按现实可行性扣分；角色目标、努力、结果完整。
向鸟索回被夺玩具，却问我们可以把玩具还给你吗；归还方向反转直接影响事件含义。
麦克斯/马克斯交替；分享骨头的角色与因果连续，寓意重复较多。
同一个欺负女孩的手足从弟弟变哥哥；事故后由莉莉明白捏人不好也弱化责任指向。
狗的项圈写成衣领；拟人狗说话可接受，磁铁故事事件完整。咀嚼磁铁只作虚构情节，不作儿童行为指南。
同一容器大锅变花盆；给种子浇水和阳光搭配损坏。长出友好怪物是允许的幻想。
蒂米/提米交替，用他指狗略生硬；探望奶奶、两次遇狗和感受变化完整。
重字典需要妈妈帮忙，翻页认词后拥抱，语法和因果连续。
玩具车飞出窗外并说话属于明确童话情节；寻找、救出与继续玩耍有完整事件链。
小狗害怕高桥，大熊帮助过桥，目标和结局明确，拟人不扣分。
看起来很困扰、制作环是直译表达；练习系鞋带的因果完整，拟人狗并非缺陷。
麦克斯/马克斯混用，借香水参加聚会的情节清楚。
鸭家庭预判风暴却看到彩虹，是故事转折而非必然逻辑矛盾；叙述自足。不能当真实雷暴避险说明。
母亲引语被错误切断，单独留下给他们并多出引号；故事主线仍在但句法明显损坏。

仙女送冒险的礼物是幻想约定，兄弟开始探索并获得快乐，故事完整。
萨姆/山姆混用；有罪的狗是guilty直译式措辞，找回玩具的关系仍清楚。
先以为小提琴自己演奏，随后发现猫在拉琴，感知转变有解释；会拉琴的猫属于童话。

恶作剧藏胡萝卜、朋友生气、归还并和解，前因后果清楚；不是现实饮食建议。
萨姆/山姆混用；颜色偏好冲突与各穿喜欢颜色的解决方法完整。

lexical_proxies.unit: CJK characters and contiguous CJK bigrams, not segmented Chinese words
lexical_proxies.limitations: Length-dependent descriptive surface diversity; no human vocabulary assessment or comparison to other corpora. Character/bigram diversity does not establish semantic/domain diversity.

decision.rationale: 32/32 self-contained story arcs and512 compatibility;9 clean,12 minor,11 major by one reviewer. This supports a filtered pilot, not automatic full-corpus acceptance. Fantastical prose is intentional and not penalized.
decision.next_gate: Prepare story-group split using unchanged tokenizer/context512, preserve oldv3/v5 held exclusion, exact/near duplicate controls and end-of-story completeness. Inspect fixed64 post-filter TRAIN stories for grammar, entity/causal continuity and translation defects. Do not rely only on punctuation or reject fiction.
decision.suggested_nonperfect_pilot_gate: Proposed prospective gate, not measured result: at least56/64 clean-or-minor and main-arc readable; no more than8/64 major; no visible physical truncation or unexplained concatenated stories. Any repeated systematic entity/direction reversal needs mitigation or explicit reconsideration even if count passes. Main task sets the final gate; no human accuracy claim.
decision.main_proposed_schedule: User/main proposal89%story/10%oldteacher/1%foundation by effective targets, B500parent,100then500updates can be a bounded continuation experiment after filtered64 and mechanical gates pass. This audit does not establish optimality or authorize a broad-chat claim; focus replay must be accounted once within mixture totals.
decision.evaluation_scope: Check story continuation coherence, entity consistency, repetition, old development degradation and original individual preservation under the main predeclared protocol; this sidecar performs no model evaluation.

scale_for_20M_targets.interpretation: Planning arithmetic20,000,000/191.625, not measured filtered yield. First shard has575898 raw rows; enough nominal scale if sufficient survive. Actual output token count must be measured; do not meet20M by repeating a tiny subset.32/32 fitting512 does not prove whole-shard fit.

observations: All32 tokenizer roundtrips passed; whole-story length116–330 tokens includingBOS/EOS.
No physical truncation or specialist/adult complexity observed in32; surface punctuation alone did not detect11 major semantic/local continuity issues.
31/32 stories start with 从前 or 有一天; recurring protagonist names and morals suggest template concentration.
6822 CJK characters contain787 distinct characters;5961 contiguous CJK bigrams contain2922 distinct types. These are surface units, not a word-vocabulary or semantic diversity score.
inferences: Better narrative self-containment than decontextualized wiki fragments is plausible from this review, but no controlled cross-corpus or model comparison was run.
Raw machine translation noise is material. A filtering-only procedure may miss entity substitutions; validate on held-back post-filter training samples rather than asserting clean quality from rules.
Native/simple-story alternatives may broaden vocabulary later; current evidence does not justify additional downloads in this bounded task.
limitations: First-shard-only fixed32 sample; not a corpus-wide population error estimate or independent human review.
No English-original alignment check; suspected translation errors are inferred from Chinese text, not measured translation fidelity.
No new old-held leakage audit performed here; main preparation must complete it before any training-ready decision.
Quoted source quality/scale claims are distinguished from local measurements.
Discovery search was bounded, not exhaustive; selected candidate is concrete and pinned, not a claim no better source exists.
